## Before You Submit

**Please search existing issues to avoid duplicates.** Your bug may already be reported.

## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Reproduction Steps

1. Set voxix to '...'
2. Press '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened instead.

## System Information

**App Version:**

<!-- You can find this in the About section of the settings window -->

**Operating System:**

<!-- e.g. macOS 14.1, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04; for Linux also desktop environment and X11/Wayland -->

**CPU:**

<!-- e.g. Apple M2, Intel i7-12700K, AMD Ryzen 7 5800X -->

**GPU:**

<!-- e.g. Apple M2 GPU, NVIDIA RTX 4080, AMD RX 6800 XT, Intel UHD Graphics -->

**Transcription model:**

<!-- The model selected in the model selector, if the problem relates to transcription -->

<!-- Attach relevant logs. Find the log location via Settings → About → App Data Directory, then attach the file. -->
